definitions.short: a cushion or pillow (as covering a seat or bed)
definitions.full: H3704. keseth [ כֶּ֫סֶת ] noun feminine band, fillet (= charm or amulet according to Ehpraimitic source Syriac, φυλακτήρια according to ὁ Ἑβραῖος of Hexapl., compare RS JPh xiii, 286 ; in Late Hebrew כסת usually = cushion, bolster, pillow ), only plural עַלֿ כְּסָתוֺת מְתַמְּרוֺת Ezek 13:18 women sewing bands upon elbows; with suffix 2 feminine plural כִּסְתוֺתֵיכֶ֫נָה 13:20 . כֶּסֶה see כֶּסֶא . כִּסֵּה see כִּסֵּא .
